recipes.name: Butter Chicken
instructions: Marinate chicken pieces with yogurt, ginger-garlic paste, and spices for 30 minutes
Cook marinated chicken in a pan until golden brown
Prepare tomato-onion base by cooking until soft and blending
Add spices to the base and cook for 2-3 minutes
Add cooked chicken and simmer for 10 minutes
Finish with cream and butter, garnish with coriander
recipes.description: Rich and creamy North Indian chicken curry with aromatic spices

recipes.name: Vegetable Biryani
instructions: Soak basmati rice for 30 minutes
Prepare vegetables by cutting into medium pieces
Fry onions until golden and crispy
Cook vegetables with spices until tender
Partially cook rice with whole spices
Layer rice and vegetables alternately
Cook on dum (slow cooking) for 45 minutes
recipes.description: Aromatic rice dish layered with spiced vegetables and fragrant basmati rice

recipes.name: Spaghetti Carbonara
instructions: Cook spaghetti in salted boiling water until al dente
Fry bacon until crispy and set aside
Beat eggs with grated cheese and black pepper
Toss hot pasta with egg mixture off the heat
Add crispy bacon and mix well
Serve immediately with extra cheese and pepper
recipes.description: Classic Italian pasta dish with creamy egg sauce and crispy bacon

recipes.name: Dal Tadka
instructions: Wash and cook lentils with turmeric until soft
Prepare tadka by heating ghee in a pan
Add cumin seeds, garlic, and ginger to hot ghee
Add chopped onions and cook until golden
Add tomatoes and cook until soft
Mix cooked lentils with tadka and simmer
Garnish with fresh coriander leaves
recipes.description: Comforting spiced lentil curry with aromatic tempering

recipes.name: Chicken Fried Rice
instructions: Cook rice and let it cool completely
Cut chicken into small pieces and marinate
Stir fry chicken until cooked through
Scramble eggs and set aside
Stir fry vegetables until crisp-tender
Add rice and mix with soy sauce
Combine everything and stir fry for 2-3 minutes
recipes.description: Quick and flavorful Chinese-style fried rice with tender chicken and vegetables

recipes.name: Paneer Butter Masala
instructions: Cut paneer into cubes and lightly fry
Prepare smooth tomato-onion puree
Cook puree with ginger-garlic paste
Add spices and cook until oil separates
Add paneer cubes and mix gently
Simmer with cream and butter
Garnish with fresh coriander
recipes.description: Creamy and rich cottage cheese curry in spiced tomato gravy

recipes.name: Margherita Pizza
instructions: Prepare pizza dough with flour, yeast, and water
Let dough rise for 1 hour
Roll out dough into pizza base
Spread tomato sauce evenly
Add mozzarella cheese and fresh basil
Drizzle with olive oil
Bake at high temperature until golden and bubbly
recipes.description: Classic Italian pizza with fresh tomatoes, mozzarella, and basil

recipes.name: Rajma Curry
instructions: Soak kidney beans overnight and pressure cook
Prepare onion-tomato base by cooking until soft
Add ginger-garlic paste and spices
Cook until oil separates from masala
Add cooked kidney beans with cooking liquid
Simmer until thick and creamy
Garnish with coriander and serve with rice
recipes.description: Hearty and protein-rich kidney bean curry in spiced tomato gravy

recipes.name: Vegetable Stir Fry
instructions: Cut all vegetables into uniform pieces
Heat oil in a wok or large pan
Add garlic and ginger, stir fry for 30 seconds
Add harder vegetables first (carrots, broccoli)
Add softer vegetables (bell peppers, onions)
Season with soy sauce and pepper
Stir fry until vegetables are crisp-tender
recipes.description: Quick and healthy mixed vegetable stir fry with Asian flavors

recipes.name: Masala Dosa
instructions: Soak rice and lentils separately for 4-6 hours
Grind to smooth batter and ferment overnight
Prepare potato filling with spices
Heat dosa pan and spread batter thinly
Cook until golden and crispy
Add potato filling and fold dosa
Serve hot with coconut chutney and sambar
recipes.description: South Indian fermented crepe filled with spiced potato curry

recipes.name: Chicken Tikka Masala
instructions: Marinate chicken in yogurt and spices for 2 hours
Grill or pan-fry chicken until charred
Prepare rich tomato-onion gravy
Add grilled chicken to the gravy
Simmer with cream and spices
Adjust seasoning and consistency
Garnish with fresh coriander
recipes.description: Smoky grilled chicken in rich and creamy tomato-based curry

recipes.name: Vegetable Pasta
instructions: Cook pasta according to package instructions
Heat olive oil and sauté garlic
Add vegetables and cook until tender
Add tomatoes and cook until soft
Toss cooked pasta with vegetables
Season with herbs and cheese
Serve hot with extra parmesan
recipes.description: Colorful pasta dish loaded with fresh seasonal vegetables
